headline: Executive session on negotiations with nonunion personnel for the Assistant Superintendent for Finance and Operations position.
summary: The School Committee will meet in executive session to discuss strategy for and conduct negotiations with nonunion personnel regarding the Assistant Superintendent for Finance and Operations.
items: Strategy session and/or negotiations with nonunion personnel for Assistant Superintendent for Finance and Operations
